_comment: Allowlist for scripts/check_health_endpoint_semantics.py (Car 0091). Governance mirrors .route-literal-allowlist.json: rationale >= 40 chars, and a STALE entry (a site that no longer probes bare /health) hard-fails. DO NOT add a site here just to silence the guard: only readiness that is GENUINELY required (a db/embed payload field is read, a DB write is gated, or the target service exposes no /health/live liveness variant at all) belongs here. A site whose caller only needs 'is the process up' is a bug — switch it to /health/live instead of allowlisting it.

yadgar/backend/embed_service/embed_servi.rationale: The embed service's OWN /health handler probing its SurrealDB dependency to decide its own readiness. SurrealDB exposes no /health/live variant; this IS the readiness check being implemented, not a caller of one.

yadgar/core/cli/seed.py:58.rationale: Gates a POST to /hooks/seed-anchor, which writes to the DB. Genuinely needs readiness (db actually connected and usable), not just process-up liveness, before attempting the write.

yadgar/core/cli/version.py:31.rationale: `yadgar version` CLI command displays db/embed/uptime fields from the readiness payload to the operator. /health/live's payload lacks those fields, so readiness is required here.

yadgar/core/daemon/daemon.py:383.rationale: YadgarDaemon.status() CLI command reports full db/model/drainer detail to the operator (including the degraded-detail body on 503). This genuinely needs the readiness payload, not liveness.

yadgar/core/daemon/daemon.py:630.rationale: _embed_health_ok probes the backend embed service (port 8001), which exposes no /health/live liveness variant at all — ADR-0019's liveness split is scoped to the core daemon only.

yadgar/core/server/http.py:458.rationale: This is core's own /health readiness handler (_probe_dependency) probing a dependency (db or embed) to build the readiness payload. It IS the readiness implementation, not a caller needing liveness.

yadgar/core/vacuum/__init__.py:175.rationale: _assert_backend_quiesced verifies NOTHING answers the backend's port before a swap (data-safety gate against the 2026-06-16 vacuum incident). Any HTTP answer at all is the failure signal; backend has no /health/live.

yadgar/core/vacuum/__init__.py:196.rationale: _wait_for_health polls the SurrealDB backend (not core), which exposes no /health/live liveness variant — the backend readiness endpoint is the only probe available for this wait.

yadgar/core/vacuum/__init__.py:215.rationale: _wait_for_yadgar_health gates vacuum finalize on the core actually being able to serve from the swapped-in DB before check_invariants runs — a data-safety hard gate that genuinely needs readiness (db connected), not just process-up liveness.

yadgar/core/vacuum/__init__.py:486.rationale: Belt-and-suspenders poll confirming the side backend's port was actually released after SIGTERM before the swap proceeds. The side backend (SurrealDB) has no /health/live variant to probe instead.

yadgar/core/vacuum/__init__.py:1186.rationale: _check_backend_reachable preflight-checks the SurrealDB backend is up before vacuum starts. Backend has no /health/live variant; readiness is the only probe available for this dependency.
